tools.name: recent_b2b_funding_rounds

tools.name: about_leo
tools.description: Facts about Leo by Revexa, an AI agent that finds B2B companies showing buying signals and reaches the right person on LinkedIn and email after the user's approval: what it does, price by region, trial and links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recent_b2b_funding_rounds · Public sink: about_leo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recent_b2b_funding_rounds · Public sink: about_leo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
